name: sgb-teaser
description: Spiritual Growth Bootcamp teaser (Remotion). Separate from the Next.js site.

scripts.preview: node scripts/make-audio.mjs && node scripts/make-campaign-audio.mjs && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render:vertical: node scripts/make-audio.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts SGB-Vertical out/sgb-teaser-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.render:wide: node scripts/make-audio.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts SGB-Wide out/sgb-teaser-wide.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.render:campaign:vertical: node scripts/make-campaign-audio.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts SGB-Campaign-Vertical out/sgb-campaign-vertical.mp4 --codec=h264
scripts.render:campaign:wide: node scripts/make-campaign-audio.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts SGB-Campaign-Wide out/sgb-campaign-wide.mp4 --codec=h264
